changes.text: CI: development → master version check no longer fails (or emails) when both branches already share the same version after a promote.
CI: promotion/auto-merge steps no longer fail the workflow (or email) when the PAT is missing, a PR already exists, or the version is not ahead of master. Build & Test failures still fail red.
Stopwatch: the X on a work item removes it from your list only. Logged time stays in Tasks and Reports. Stop the timer first.
Stopwatch: Delete work item (and all of its sessions) is inside Sessions, not on the list.
The installed app opens on the mini stopwatch.
Initial My.Workspace product baseline on a clean anonymized history.
Tyme: Tasks (All / Week / Project), stopwatch, calendar sync, submissions, reports, and management.
Organizations as its own menu and role scope (User view, Editor create/edit; archive/delete stay with global Admin).
Intranet knowledge base with Drive library support.
Multi-tenant Google sign-in with configurable allowed email domains.
Task and stopwatch free-text field is Details end-to-end; blank Details store as empty.
Greenfield database schema is baked into InitialMigration for first-time installs.
